# People Atlas 0.7.0 — Alpha

> [!WARNING]
> People Atlas 0.7.0 is an alpha version of the plugin. Its fundamental
> behavior is subject to change in future releases.

> [!IMPORTANT]
> **Compatibility: People Atlas 0.7.0 only supports Obsidian 1.13.0 or newer.
> Obsidian 1.12.x and older are not supported.**

This release adds Reading View-only contextual edit actions while keeping every
editor write explicit and reviewable. Publishing People Atlas in the Community
Plugins directory remains a separate step from this GitHub release.

## Changes

- Added native **Edit person** and **Edit relationship** buttons to canonical
  People Atlas person and relationship notes in Reading View only.
- Buttons appear only when their rendered note is a current, unique canonical
  record; non-People-Atlas, stale, and ambiguous notes show no action.
- Every click reuses the existing path-based editor and revalidates immediately,
  so stale or ambiguous notes cannot open the wrong record or write data before
  an explicit editor **Save**.

## Assets

Install or update the plugin with the attached `main.js`, `manifest.json`, and
`styles.css`.
